# DENTAL INFECTIONS

Surgical drainage, scaling and antimicrobial treatment are essential. All patients should be referred to the dental service for assessment and direction of treatment. Empirical coverage for likely pathogens (streptococci, Peptostreptococcus, Finegoldia, Bacteriodes and other oral anaerobes) is required.

## TOOTH ABSCESS AND OTHER SUPPURATIVE ODONTOGENIC INFECTIONS

Surgical drainage, scaling and antimicrobial treatment are essential and tooth extraction is required in most cases. All patients should be referred to the dental service for assessment and direction of treatment. Empirical coverage for likely pathogens (streptococci, Peptostreptococcus, Finegoldia, Bacteriodes and other oral anaerobes is required. Immunocompromised patients need additional coverage for Pseudomonas aeruginosa.

## Treatment of mild to moderate disease in immunocompetent patients or step-down

## therapy after initial intravenous therapy. Adjust duration for a total of 7-14

## days of antimicrobial therapy.

Preferred:
Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO q12h for 7 to 14 days ($) [R]

Alternative:
Clindamycin 450 mg PO q8h for 7 to 14 days ($) [H,O]

## Treatment of severe disease in immunocompetent patients

Preferred:
Ampicillin-sulbactam 3gm IV once STAT ($) [R]

Alternative:
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV once STAT ($) [M] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV once STAT ($) [DI]

## Treatment in immunocompromised patients

Preferred:
Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV once STAT ($$) [R]

Alternative:
Meropenem 1 gm IV once STAT ($$) [R,O]
